operational_learning.text: In this zsh, an unquoted glob in grep --include=*.meta.json is expanded by the shell and fails with 'no matches found'. Use grep -rl "<mission name>:" <subagents dir>/ (the description is followed by a colon) without --include. Both 874d-8 (its L67, L71) and this mission hit it

A safety-classifier refusal in a delegate gives it exactly two attempts: Claude Code injects a meta message and the model is called again; a second refusal ends the delegate with a synthetic API error. Anything the delegate held only in its context is lost; only files it wrote survive. Delegates on long analytic missions should write their work product to disk in batches

Refusal forensics need no thinking content: the refused assistant record carries message.stop_reason, message.stop_details (type, category, explanation), message.usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens, top-level thinkingDurationMs, requestId and serverClassifierRequest; the synthetic error record carries isApiErrorMessage, error and refusedMessageId; the meta user record carries refusedMessageId. api-request-blob records replay earlier turns, thinking parts included, so a thinking-free reader must skip thinking parts in those records too
